39-year-old male history of Graves disease has a occasionally had episodes of low back strain was leaning over and felt acute pain recently use ibuprofen yesterday no self-treatment today has pain with movement
No fevers no history of cancer
No history of IV drug use
No incontinence retention
Is ambulatory
Able to tolerate NSAIDs per patient
Some pain down right back not beyond knee
Had CT scan abdomen pelvis 10/24 bones noted to be normal
Allergies: Penicillin
Past medical history: Essential tremor, Graves disease
Medications: Methimazole
Alert afebrile
No percussion tenderness midline L-spine no rash on back
5/5 motor strength bilateral knee ankle big toe flexion-extension
Straight leg raise elicits back pain and spasm no radicular symptoms
Steady gait
Positional movements reproduce back pain
Impression/plan
Low back strain
-May have element of sciatica will treat with ketorolac IM Will DC with the acetaminophen and ibuprofen DC with return precautions patient happy with the plan
I personally spent total 16 minutes in face-to-face and non-face-to-face activities
related to the patient’s visit today, excluding any separately reportable
services/procedures
